name: A Seduced Wife
source:
The story is about Sandra and Paolo, an Italian married couple who move to France with their children after the death of Sandra's mother. The couple lives in a very peculiar family situation. There seems to have been a problem in Milan and Sandra wanted to move to France precisely to rebuild the love relationship with her husband and escape from the past. But unfortunately things will become more complicated for Sandra, betrayals, unspoken things and a past that resurfaces as time goes by are the subjects of this novel.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/stef3d]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕意大利夫妇Sandra与Paolo展开。Sandra的母亲过世后，两人带着孩子移居法国。他们的家庭关系很不寻常，似乎曾在米兰遇到过问题，而Sandra之所以想搬到法国，正是为了重建与丈夫的爱情、逃离过去。可惜，情况只会越来越复杂。背叛、未说出口的话，以及随着时间推移重新浮现的往事，构成了这部小说的主题。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/stef3d]Patreon[/url]]
